gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Noto Sans New Tai Lue reads with rounded, cupped letters that feel modern and unfussy, never clenched or tight. Bruno Ace SC above it has no hairlines to lose.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo reads modern, with openings you can see through. Bruno Ace SC brings a marker-drawn plainness to every character, and that distinctive, expressive heading is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-nko-unj: Bruno Ace SC builds each letter from a single stroke width, spaced out like beads on a thread. It handles display work; Noto Sans NKo Unjoined handles the reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Round, spacious and a bit futuristic: Bruno Ace SC draws its bowls with an outline that never swells or thins. Noto Sans Old South Arabian adds approachable curved strokes that stop before they turn inward, and that gentle ending is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Bruno Ace SC is built on a monoline skeleton, with open apertures and letters strung out like beads on a thread. Noto Sans Shavian follows with rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends, keeping the page contemporary and clean.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ojuju: Constant-width pen lines, then a softer turn. Bruno Ace SC is at its best being distinctive and expressive up top, while Ojuju does its best work with a mellow range of stroke weights and wide, barely curled s curves.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-overpass: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-aperture letters out like beads on a long thread, expressive and unmistakable in a display role. Overpass keeps its strokes consistent within each word, so extended reading stays modern and steady.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-palanquin: Spaghetti laid out in letters: that is Bruno Ace SC, expressive and loosely strung with open apertures. Palanquin follows with curved letters and wide, unclosed mouths, so a larger heading over modest body text feels like a sensible suggestion.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-philosopher: Philosopher offers curves with plenty of daylight inside and soft shifts in thickness that never turn stark, a gentle presence. Bruno Ace SC adds rounds and stems in a single weight above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-pontano-sans: Bruno Ace SC looks drawn by a pen that never changes pressure or angle, with open apertures and generous spacing between letters. Pontano Sans adds wide open terminals, and that contrast of a distinctive heading and a contemporary body is the pair's strength.
